from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(..., description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(..., description="The stock code of the company")
    net_profit: float | None = Field(..., description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(..., description="Accounts Receivable")
    inventory: float | None = Field(..., description="Inventory")
    report_period: str | None = Field(..., description="The reporting period, e.g., 2025-Q1")
    currency: str | None = Field(..., description="Currency of the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[FinancialReport]
